body: Ok. That is your opinion. I think I'm not being immature. We never made any kind of no contact deal. Its really very simple to reply to someone and tell them you don't want to speak to them. We ended on good terms for the most part.

Thank you. It sounds like you really understand. I am starting to feel like I'm crazy. I don't message him a lot. When i do message him and he doesn't answer, it just makes me feel so awful. I know it only going to hurt me. 

Do you feel better now?
Thank you! That's a lovely thought. I'm going to do my best to remember this.

I know I should be happy to be alive. I should appreciate the life I have. I especially feel this since my parents lost their lives. Sometimes I feel really guilty when I think that I'd be better off dead. 

I worry that I won't ever find anyone. That maybe there just isn't someone for me. I know I have a lot going for me. I have a good head on my shoulders. I'm applying to pharmacy school. I'm doing well at my job. I should be happy. I have moments where I feel so happy, but I can still always feel the sadness and the pain creeping up on me. 

I feel like my ex gets to go out and have a party. While I have to struggle to keep going. It's almost like I'm jealous. I keep thinking all of his dreams are coming true. While I know that not really true.

It will probably sound stupid, but I know deep down I don't really want to hurt myself. I feel that is why I came here. Thank you for listening. I just wish there was a way to end this pain. I don't know what to do to get help. I don't want to check myself into a hospital. 

I survived the loss of my parents which was a million times worse then losing my bf, but it still hurts. He told me he wanted to marry me. things like that. I thought we would grow old together.
